dedupe_keys.name: dataset of the synthetic data generation for the prototyping of bridge damage detection algorithms

description: A University of Bath team deposits synthetic modal-frequency outputs for prototyping bridge-damage detection algorithms. Zenodo lists twenty public CSV files under CC BY 4.0, representing 7,300 finite-element iterations across twenty structural states. The provider says Ansys Mechanical and Workbench varied Young’s modulus and exported frequencies; file names distinguish deck damage, column damage, settlement and thermal variants. These outputs can benchmark whether a detection method separates stiffness loss from temperature or support model sensitivity tests. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this synthetic bridge collection. A limitation is that the description calls the twenty files Excel sheets, whereas the public inventory lists CSV; field schema and units were not checked. Simulated modal changes do not validate detection against measured bridge vibration or real deterioration. The source model and boundary conditions are not described on the page. No file was downloaded and no modal frequency was recalculated.
